headline: ptrace L2 frontier is mature; EVERY multi-backend compat gap found routes to the pinned reverie dependency (approval-gated + pin bump). No in-tree hermit code fix was landable this round.

findings.ptrace: Mature. 20+ harder single-process programs L2 (crypto, interp, compute-locale, mmap/pipe/epoll/signal/ioctl/getrusage/sched_yield). No fresh in-tree gap.

sabre.rdtscp: RDTSCP (0F 01 F9) not intercepted -> raw host TSC leaks (see sabre_rdtscp_gap_20260728).
sabre.rpc_panic_on_fork_wrapper: date (Meta fork wrapper) aborts: panic at reverie-rpc-transport/src/blocking_client.rs:97 'Socket operation on non-socket' (ENOTSOCK, code 88) -> core dump.

dbi.copied_child_ioctl: strict copied pre-exec child fail-closes on ioctl/recvmsg/recvmmsg/readlink[at] (detcore-dbi reverie_dbi_runtime_copied_syscall, PR-981 deliberate); breaks bash pipelines like 'echo|base32|base32 -d'. Needs reverie-dbi ABI to pass syscall args (pinned).
dbi.clock: #705 effectively FIXED: date -u +%Y prints 2026 under dbi (was 1970).

liteinst.interception_incomplete_nondeterministic: glibc-internal syscalls (locale file opens) execute natively/untraced; single-proc awk shows 5 committed turns vs ptrace 27. Under --strict --verify the committed syscall sequence VARIES run-to-run: awk-compute flakes 3/30 (~10%) with 'Mismatch between run 1 and run 2' though stdout is stable.
liteinst.no_fork_clone: 'reverie-liteinst: clone/fork injection is unsupported' -> any fork (date wrapper) or thread (python threading -> 'can't start new thread') fails.
liteinst.no_pmu_timer: '--backend=liteinst does not implement PMU/RCB timer delivery; continuing with --max-timeslice=disabled.'

findings.kvm: Uses distinct verify (output+exit-status compare, not log). echo L2. Various un-enumerated-syscall gaps in reverie-kvm executor (pinned).

fix_disposition: All gaps are in the pinned reverie dependency (reverie-sabre / third-party/sabre, reverie-dbi ABI, reverie-liteinst, reverie-kvm, reverie-rpc-transport). Each is an interception-semantics change to a core Reverie contract -> requires user approval + reverie feature branch + parent pin bump per Reverie API Policy. detcore-liteinst/src/lib.rs is a 34-line constructor with no interception lever; detcore-dbi copied-child gate cannot distinguish safe ioctls without args from the pinned ABI.
prior_round: compat_push_survey_20260728 (ptrace, landed draft PR #1041 ivar guard).
